title: Forward and Back
subtitle: 旅行见闻 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 旅行见闻（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与见闻）
meta: 主题语境：旅行见闻（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与见闻）　|　核心词汇：forward　|　正文 307 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 forward 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Forward, in 1989 the farmer pushed the basket at the fence, and everybody in the field said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three autumns on, people still spoke of that morning: the farmer had pushed the basket ② forward without complaint, and nobody had asked a single question. The farmer had come to the field two autumns earlier, and spoke little of the field he had left behind him.

The almanac for September 1983 puts it plainer. The basket was ③ forward, and the child who kept it wrote of the basket ④ forward in the same line; nothing in the field was ever left forward for long in those days. The child wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every autumn thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the basket at the far fence, meant something else. He had come from ⑤ forward, and ⑥ Forward came the child who was to carry it back; he was not a man who explained himself, and the field had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1996 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the almanac. What the line asked for was that the basket be sowed ⑦ forward at the fence, and that everybody be ⑧ forward before the September rains. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried forward.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1999 she pushed the basket ⑨ forward with great care when nobody else would, and ⑩ Forward, she said in 2001, that was the part the field never forgot; the almanac still speaks of it forward. She kept the basket in the same fence for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the field never forgot how forward it had all been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 向前（句末状语，置于宾语之后：pushed the basket forward，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 向前（作表语，说明处所或去向：the basket was forward）
C. adv. 向将来（置于句首：Forward, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 向将来（作后置定语，紧跟被修饰的名词：the basket forward）
E. adv. 向将来（作介词宾语：from forward）
F. adv. 向将来（句首强调，引起全部倒装：Forward came the child）
G. adv. 向前（被动结构中置于过去分词之后：be sowed forward at the fence）
H. adv. 向前（be forward 说明所在或去向：everybody be forward before the rains）

answers.why: forward 意为“向将来”，此处置于句首交代地点或去向：Forward, in 1989 …。
forward 意为“向前”，此处置于宾语之后作状语：had pushed the basket forward。
forward 意为“向前”，此处作表语说明那件小小的竹篮的去向或所在：was forward。
forward 意为“向将来”，此处作后置定语紧跟名词：the basket forward。
forward 意为“向将来”，此处作介词 from 的宾语：from forward。
forward 意为“向将来”，此处置于句首引起全部倒装：Forward came the child。
forward 意为“向前”，被动结构中副词置于过去分词之后：be sowed forward at the fence。
forward 意为“向前”，be forward 说明众人须在雨季前到达某处或处于某状态。
forward 意为“向前”，1999 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次推那件小小的竹篮，副词置于句末。
forward 意为“向将来”，母亲 2001 年那句话以地点状语开头：Forward, …。
